titleEn: A Surprise at the Fruit and Flower Mountain

art.enemyPrompt: A full body chibi sticker of a pale ghost stands on a flat magenta background, with a thick outline and no text. It has a rounded white-blue sheet body, two dark oval eyes, a small open dark mouth, and two short stubby arms.
art.bossPrompt: A full body chibi sticker of a little demon stands on a flat magenta background, with a thick outline and no text. The little demon is a pale ghost with a rounded white-blue sheet body, two dark oval eyes, a small open dark mouth, and two short stubby arms, and is not dressed as Sun Wukong.
art.backdropPrompt: A wide 16:9 children's storybook landscape for the generic theme and the title A Surprise at the Fruit and Flower Mountain: a bright daytime sky with soft clouds, a sudden sunlit clearing among peach blossoms and round fruit trees, a distant waterfall beside pale rocky cliffs, and warm grassy ground. A clear empty dirt path runs through the center, open and unoccupied. Painted as a gentle watercolor storybook scene with no characters, no animals, no letters, and no writing.
